fields.title: Samoa company profile / search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Detail-mode records (_source: S1-catalyst-detail, the default) carry the full company profile, with field names taken VERBATIM from the labels MCIL's own 'View Company Details' page displays (e.g. 'Company Status', 'Incorporation Date') -- this is deliberate: the register exposes no JSON REST API, only server-rendered HTML, so the label text IS upstream's own field vocabulary. Summary-mode records (_source: S1-catalyst-searchresult, when 'Fetch full company profile' is off) carry only the search-result row.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-catalyst-detail (full profile), S1-catalyst-searchresult (summary row only), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), detail_fetch_failed / blocked_or_transient (network or session issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

registrationNumber.title: Registration number
registrationNumber.description: MCIL company registration number (e.g. 0456, or a longer numeric id for newer registrations).

entityTypeLabel.title: Entity type
entityTypeLabel.description: Register category shown on the search result badge, e.g. 'Companies' (only category observed during recon -- this register did not surface a separate sole-trader/business-name category).

Company Name.title: Company name (detail tab)
Company Name.description: Detail-mode only: registered name as shown on the General Details tab, sometimes with the entity type appended.

Incorporation Date.title: Incorporation date
Incorporation Date.description: Original registration date, as displayed by MCIL (free-text date, not normalized).

Re-Registration Date.title: Re-registration date
Re-Registration Date.description: Date the company was re-registered under the current Companies Act 2001 system, if applicable.

Company Rules.title: Company rules
Company Rules.description: Whether the company uses the Act's model rules or its own custom rules.

Trading As.title: Trading as
Trading As.description: Trading/business name, if different from the registered name.

Business Activity.title: Business activity
Business Activity.description: Industry sector and sub-sector, MCIL's own classification text.

Annual Return Filing Month.title: Annual return filing month
Annual Return Filing Month.description: Month the company's annual return is due.

Annual Return Last Filed on.title: Annual return last filed on
Annual Return Last Filed on.description: Date the most recent annual return was filed.

Previous Name.title: Previous name
Previous Name.description: A prior registered name on file, if the company has been renamed.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: Detail-mode only: list of address records (Registered Office Address, Postal Address, Address for Service), each with Start Date and, if superseded, End Date.

directors.title: Directors
directors.description: Detail-mode only: list of directors, each with Name, Residential Address, Postal Address, Director Consent date, and Ceased date if no longer a director. Includes historical (ceased) directors, not just current ones.

shareholders.title: Shareholders
shareholders.description: Detail-mode only: list of shareholders -- individuals (Name, Citizenship) or corporate shareholders (Entity Name, Place of Incorporation), each with Registered Office Address, Appointed date, Ceased date if applicable, and whether the shareholder is also a director.

shareParcels.title: Share parcels
shareParcels.description: Detail-mode only: list of {Number of shares, Name or Entity Name} -- per-shareholder share counts.

filings.title: Filing history
filings.description: Detail-mode only: list of {filingType, submittedAt, filedAt} -- every filing lodged against this company (annual returns, notices of change of directors/shareholders, rule amendments, etc.). The filing DOCUMENT itself is not downloaded, only this metadata.

entityTypeAbbrev.title: Entity type abbreviation
entityTypeAbbrev.description: Summary-mode only: the search result's badge abbreviation (e.g. 'COM').

address.title: Address (search result)
address.description: Summary-mode only: the single address line shown on the search-result row.

previousNames.title: Previous names (search result)
previousNames.description: Summary-mode only: list of prior registered names shown on the search-result row.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both full-profile and search-summary records.
